## Purpose

_Why this chapter exists. A single paragraph that tells the reader whether they need to read this._

## Scope

_What this chapter covers and, equally important, what it explicitly does not cover._

_Context required to understand the content. Assumptions about the reader's knowledge._

## Design

_The core content. Descriptions, architectural decisions, rationale, and diagrams._

_Diagrams MUST use Mermaid. Every diagram must have a caption and a reference in the text._

## Data Flow

_How data moves through this component or system. Sequence diagrams preferred._

## Failure Scenarios

_What can break and how the system responds. Every non-trivial component MUST document at least one failure mode._

## Trade-offs

_What alternatives were considered, what was chosen, and why. Record rejected alternatives honestly._

## Future Improvements

_What could be done later but was deferred. This section prevents re-debating settled decisions._
